cells.premiseAvailability: ["(a) operand field's declared qualifier", "(b) transition event's arg qualifier", "(c) transition row `when` guard narrowing an open operand"]

dischargeContract.derivation: Discharges IFF the shared decision procedure resolves both operands and finds them compatible. Class (c) instance for this cell: the transition row's `when` guard (GuardOfContext -> TransitionRowContext.Row.Guard, QualifierNarrowing.cs:199) narrows an open operand field to a single axis value across all disjunctive branches, and that field is not reassigned earlier in the row's action chain.
dischargeContract.decisionProcedure: Finite two-step qualifier resolution on the named axis for each operand, then ordinal token equality; a temporal dimension of Any is refused. Reject iff either operand fails to resolve or the two tokens differ.

suggestions.schema: declare the same ⟨axis⟩ value on both operands
narrow the open operand under a guard to ⟨the other operand's axis value⟩

base.program:
precept QC1
state Draft initial
state Posted terminal
field Fee as money in 'USD' default '0 USD' nonnegative
field Payment as money default '0 USD'
field Total as money default '0 USD'
event Post()
from Draft on Post -> set Total = Payment + Fee -> transition Posted

discharges.derivation: the open operand is narrowed under the row guard to the value the other operand declares, so both resolve to the same token on the axis.
